_: The seven v1 classes (docs/v1_class_roster.md), built on SRD 5.2.1 chassis (CC-BY-4.0). The base two actions are solo compensation, not a stand-in for Extra Attack: Extra Attack ports literally as one more action every round, and Action Surge as one more action per rest (decisions_checklist.md section 1, corrected 2026-09-23).
